minus8_effective_scope.global_statement: Every N at least 2^78 with 16 not dividing N is a sum of two positive primitive -8 norm values.
minus8_effective_scope.all_prime_statement: Every prime N at least 2 belongs to P_-8+P_-8; analytic threshold 2^22 plus exhaustive retained finite certificate.
minus8_effective_scope.remaining_exact_classification: Resolved by PRIMITIVE_NORM_MINUS8_EXACT.md: exact C+C and C+2C identities, 107 rational intervals, full finite coverage through2^27 and split-prime descent. No direct exhaustion of every core below2^60 is asserted.
minus8_effective_scope.priority: The dyadic identities and finite-quotient method are classical; no priority claim for these explicit specializations.
minus8_effective_scope.distinct_value_lower_bound: At least N^(2/3)/4800 ordered value pairs for every N>=2^78 with16 not dividing N.

analytic_audit.status: Internal mathematical audit; no external human review or formal verification.
analytic_audit.exponent: Every fixed eta<1/18; eta=1/20 by alpha=15/16, D=N^(1/18), epsilon=1/1000 in the unified error budget.
analytic_audit.completion: Weighted absolute Euler product for every fixed alpha<1, uniformly in N and all valuations. Target factors have N^o(1) product, but need not be 1+O(1/p).
analytic_audit.local_test: Existing maximum-valuation modulus is valid; minimum determinant valuation also suffices because both blocks are primitive.
analytic_audit.consequences: Linear coordinate lower bound for same-field pairs; N/sqrt(loglog(3N)) for distinct fields. Distinct value count at least a constant times N S*(N)^3/(1+log N)^6.
analytic_audit.replay: Existing checker replayed at bound256, including all295947 primes through2^22, with matching hashes. Separate finite spectral matrices are exploratory normalization evidence.
